mapper.sql: SELECT M.DM_SYS_CD as "sysCd" ,S.SYS_NM as "sysNm" ,M.DM_ID as "dmId" ,M.DM_NM as "dmNm" ,A.OBJ_OWNER as "objOwner" ,A.OBJ_NM as "objNm" ,O.OBJ_NM_KR as "objNmKr" ,A.ATTR_NM as "attrNm" ,A.ATTR_NM_KR as "attrNmKr" ,A.DATA_TYPE as "dataType" ,A.DATA_LEN as "dataLen" ,A.DATA_DECIMAL_LEN as "dataDecimalLen" ,A.ATTR_ORD as "attrOrd" ,A.PRIV_YN as "attrPrivYn" ,A.ENCR_YN as "attrEncrYn" ,T.TERMS_NM as "termsNm" ,T.PRIV_YN as "termsPrivYn" ,T.ENCR_YN as "termsEncrYn" ,T.DOMAIN_NM as "domainNm" ,D.PRIV_YN as "domainPrivYn" ,D.ENCR_YN as "domainEncrYn" ,COALESCE(A.PRIV_YN, T.PRIV_YN, D.PRIV_YN, 'N') as "privYn" ,CASE WHEN A.PRIV_YN IS NOT NULL THEN 'COLUMN' WHEN T.PRIV_YN IS NOT NULL THEN 'TERMS' WHEN D.PRIV_YN IS NOT NULL THEN 'DOMAIN' ELSE 'NONE' END as "privSrc" ,COALESCE(A.ENCR_YN, T.ENCR_YN, D.ENCR_YN, 'N') as "encrYn" ,CASE WHEN A.ENCR_YN IS NOT NULL THEN 'COLUMN' WHEN T.ENCR_YN IS NOT NULL THEN 'TERMS' WHEN D.ENCR_YN IS NOT NULL THEN 'DOMAIN' ELSE 'NONE' END as "encrSrc" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL M ON M.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(M.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O ON O.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND O.OBJ_OWNER = A.OBJ_OWNER AND O.OBJ_NM = A.OBJ_NM LEFT JOIN TB_SYS_INFO S ON S.SYS_CD = M.DM_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (DICT_ID, TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM) DICT_ID, TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM, TERMS_NM, DOMAIN_NM, PRIV_YN, ENCR_YN FROM TB_TERMS WHERE APRV_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY DICT_ID, TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM, TERMS_NM) T ON T.DICT_ID = M.DICT_ID AND T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM = TRIM(A.ATTR_NM) LEFT JOIN TB_DOMAIN D ON D.DICT_ID = T.DICT_ID AND D.DOMAIN_NM = T.DOMAIN_NM WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(A.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE SYS (SYS_CD, DEPTH) AS ( SELECT SYS_CD, 0 FROM TB_SYS_INFO WHERE SYS_CD = #{sysCd} UNION ALL SELECT C.SYS_CD, SYS.DEPTH + 1 FROM TB_SYS_INFO C JOIN SYS ON C.P_SYS_CD = SYS.SYS_CD WHERE SYS.DEPTH < 20 )
SELECT * FROM (
AND M.DM_SYS_CD IN (SELECT SYS_CD FROM SYS)
AND A.DM_ID = #{dmId}
AND A.OBJ_OWNER = #{objOwner}
AND (A.OBJ_NM ILIKE '%' || #{objNm} || '%' OR O.OBJ_NM_KR ILIKE '%' || #{objNm} || '%')
AND (A.ATTR_NM ILIKE '%' || #{attrNm} || '%' OR A.ATTR_NM_KR ILIKE '%' || #{attrNm} || '%')
) X WHERE 1 = 1
AND X."privYn" = 'Y'
AND X."privYn" = 'Y' AND X."encrYn" = 'N'
ORDER BY X."sysNm", X."dmNm", X."objOwner", X."objNm", X."attrOrd", X."attrNm"
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR SET PRIV_YN = #{val, jdbcType=CHAR} WHERE (DM_ID, OBJ_OWNER, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM) IN
(#{k.dmId}, #{k.objOwner}, #{k.objNm}, #{k.attrNm})

UPDATE TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR SET ENCR_YN = #{val, jdbcType=CHAR} WHERE (DM_ID, OBJ_OWNER, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM) IN
(#{k.dmId}, #{k.objOwner}, #{k.objNm}, #{k.attrNm})
mapper.select: SELECT M.DM_ID as "dmId", M.DM_NM as "dmNm", M.DM_SYS_CD as "sysCd" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(M.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY M.DM_NM
SELECT DISTINCT OBJ_OWNER FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY OBJ_OWNER
